page.layout: One page of text: running head at top, then running text in paragraphs, a centred italic motto with a rule below it, and the closing word FINIS at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ge Eorum temeratas licet at pœnitentes animas
Filii tui Sanguine, ut Interfector Angelus
Quanquam nimis angusta Regna Mea vide-
rentur quæ Me & Illos simul caperent, capax Il-
lud tamen Misericordiæ Tuæ Immensæ Regnum
Redemptoris Sanguine, longe supra evademus am-
bitiosa illa desideria, & unde fera hæc odia pro-
Et cum in Me Manus eorum incubuerint cru-
deli maximè & gravi pondere, O in brachia ca-
nam viderunt oculi Mei Salutare Tuum.

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page; its opening letters ("ge") are cut off at the left edge. The dark marks along the left edge are show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The printed "Eorum" and "Filii" are copied as printed. The motto is set in large italic under a rule and is treated as a level 2 heading.
